title: Explosions reported on Qeshm Island and at Jask; two tankers reportedly hit mines or on fire in Hormuz
detail: Explosions were reported on Iran's Qeshm Island and at Jask, and Iranian-sourced reports say two oil tankers caught fire or struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Cause, vessel identities and casualties are not independently confirmed. Further tanker losses would add to shipping and insurance disruption affecting food and fertiliser import flows.
confidenceReason: Attributed to Iran; no independent confirmation (e.g. UKMTO) in the triage data.

title: IRGC says three tankers ablaze in Hormuz, accuses them of using unauthorized routes
detail: Iran's IRGC said three tankers were on fire in the Strait of Hormuz and accused them of using unauthorized shipping routes; Iranian-sourced reports earlier said two tankers caught fire after hitting mines. Cause, vessel identities and casualties are not independently confirmed. Further tanker losses would deepen shipping and insurance disruption affecting food and fertiliser flows.
